text: Standing in this sleek, modern space devoted to research and development, I feel energized and curious. The bold design, interactive screens, and clever use of color all seem to invite me into a world of ideas and possibilities. There’s a sense of anticipation—of being on the threshold of discovery—where human creativity and technology intertwine. I feel small, yet a part of something much larger. Above all, I feel awake and receptive to whatever insights might emerge here.
